svg.title: Incommensurate Shock Textile
svg.desc: Thirty-seven phase-shifted resonances use two incommensurate frequencies far beyond the usual maximum 12. A finite 3000-sample trace records dense interference without ever closing cleanly, making the oscillators look like woven shock fronts. Native toolbar flow: normal spline bristles → reflected resonance chambers, with a luminance-preserving monochrome palette.
